'''2007 Georgia State Championship Brandon Ruck LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Ruck]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Light Deck
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
